title: Research: conditionally exclude the literal P112 2,5,6^8 caller
body:
## Summary

```diff
 literal P112 independent-piece caller 2,5,6^8, code dimension >=6
- PR3397 forces eight distinct projective quotient endpoints
+ incidence forces at least nine root-normal triples
+ a forced orthogonal-root four-endpoint configuration has no fifth endpoint
+ the literal caller is excluded under the stated inherited premises
```

The new result closes PR3397's actual three-endpoint handoff over every characteristic-zero field. It inherits the exact PR3397 four-piece theorem/capacities at `10ac93be8dbf2ba5f85859dbeec90895ebbbabfd` and the standard E8 Weyl-chamber premise. That predecessor's large census is retained and hashed, not independently replayed here. PR3253/3322's existing 1,200-direction classification is rechecked and credited. The new work is the root-triple incidence argument and complete fifth-endpoint exclusion.

Only `research/p112-three-endpoint-sparsity/` is added. The package includes the written proof, exact sources, two implementations, frozen set receipts, controls, bounded replay and open review questions. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19008892).

## Evidence

- Before: the actual `2,5,6^8` caller remained open after the four-piece obstruction. After: its triple-incidence allowance is 3,772, forcing at least nine root triples against the eight-triple pair-linear cap. The resulting four-endpoint configuration has no fifth endpoint.
- Primary Weyl/pencil and separate explicit-coordinate/projection implementations agree on all 360 normalized candidates and 32 first-pencil pairs, all at parameter two. No second-pencil pair survives. Full set digests agree; a separate integer DP corroborates the incidence allowance.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized Python 3.15 checks, eight behavioral groups with four actual optimized CLI rejections, metadata/source pins, Ruff and formatting pass. The determinant control corrected a swapped triple-name expectation in the test. Production formulas were unchanged. Strict receipt comparison rejects Boolean/number substitutions.
- Exact committed-byte and read-only Git-free export checks are recorded in the publication receipt. Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-three-endpoint-sparsity
```

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3397/3295/3289/3322/3253/3161/3162, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112 lineage. This is internal computational corroboration and a written conditional proof. Human/proof-kernel review remains open. No full C5, public residue count, decoder floor, physical supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Historical heavy suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker are unrun.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

The new opt-in package leaves frozen inputs and the selected result unchanged. Its mathematical conclusion depends on the named inherited premises.
